1 قَبَطَهُ , aor.
قَبِطَ , so in the margin of a copy of the S, (TA,) inf. n. قَبْطٌ, (TS, O, K,) He collected it together, or comprehended it, with his hand: (TS, O, K:) [like قَبَضَهُ:) in the TS given as on the authority of IDrd: in the O as on that of IF. (TA.) ―
-b2- Also, inf. n. as above, He mixed it. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
